connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

personId.description: LeadIQ person identifier for the contact you are reporting feedback about.

value.description: The corrected email address or phone number value you are submitting feedback for.

status.description: Contact info status. Allowed values: Correct or Invalid.

type.description: Contact info type. Common values include WorkEmail, WorkPhone, PersonalEmail, and PersonalPhone.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL for the person you are reporting feedback about.

linkedinId.description: LinkedIn member ID for the person you are reporting feedback about.

name.description: Name of the person the feedback refers to.

companyId.description: LeadIQ company identifier associated with the person.

companyName.description: Company name associated with the person.

companyDomain.description: Company domain associated with the person.

title.description: Job title associated with the person.

invalidReason.description: Reason the value is invalid. Use one of LeadIQ's InvalidReason enum values such as WrongPerson or Other.

lastSeen.description: When the contact value was last seen, as an ISO date-time.
